system.description: Demesnes can exist in shadowlands; in this case, tendrils of iron and tokens of bone anchor a small shadowland to a manse. The manse might even envelop the shadowland; for instance, a bone-lined cellar with a door that merges with the Underworld at night. Fed by the manse's Essence, the shadowland becomes permanent, never growing or shrinking for any reason save Power Failure.
